verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own ability to export traces via the UI or API, and publishes a full OpenAPI spec for programmatic access to resources, so trace data can be pulled out. Nothing documents a complete account-wide export (datasets, experiments, feedback, prompts, dashboards) or the open file formats an export would use. Missing for 10: documented full-account or bulk export covering all data types, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON, CSV or OTel output), offboarding or migration guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation of export completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
The LangSmith API is used to programmatically create and manage LangSmith resources
Self-hosted LangSmith runs the LangSmith platform in your own infrastructure so that trace and operational data stay in your environment.
